svg.title: Toonverse wireframe 04: Series & Episodes
svg.text: Low-fidelity wireframe, not a final UI design · Toonverse Task 011 (0.11) · Desktop-first (Issue #17 D5)
A baker who can only open her shop at night.
Click a title to rename it inline. Up and Down reorder: episodes are renumbered 1, 2, 3 ... (Task 4.14).
"Publish..." opens the Publish step in the episode workspace (Module 08). A draft cannot be unpublished.
Never published. Only the owner sees it.
Visible on Discover and in the Reader.
Hidden from public pages. Panels, pictures
and the publish date are kept. Action: Publish...
Publishing again after edits is allowed (S10).
This deletes the episode, its notes and its panels.
Numbers keep their gaps after a delete (Issue #8).
The dialog states how many episodes are deleted.
On success: go to /dashboard with a toast (Task 4.15).
It disappears from Discover and the Reader.
Its panels, pictures and publish date are kept.
The episode table becomes a list: number and title
on top, status tag and last saved below.
Row actions move into a "More" menu.
Series title and description fields stack;
Save and Delete series sit below them.
actions are shown here; the Publish step
Episode fields: number, title, status, last
